chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) in
a freed slave woman was slandered by a male slave, he said: He is flogged with eighty [lashes] because he is only flogged for her right.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a male slave who slanders a free chaste woman?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar clarifies that a male slave (abd) accused of slandering a free, chaste woman (hurrah) receives eighty lashes, distinguishing this ruling from the standard hudud penalty. The Imam explains that the punishment is specifically for the woman's right (haqq al-mar'ah), implying that the slave's status does not reduce the penalty in this context, unlike the general rule where slaves receive half the lashes of free men. This highlights the Shia juristic view on the consistency of compensation for the victim's honor regardless of the accuser's social rank.
